_comment: Task 27b. Workspace identity colors (Forge/Lab/Arena/Observe/Vault/Range) live in colors.json and are deliberately NOT themed here - they stay constant across every theme (Design-Vision.md sec 2, Theme.qml's own header comment). A theme controls only: chrome (surface/raised/text), one accent (used by kitty/hyprlock/dunst - Quickshell's own chrome keeps using the active workspace's color as its accent, unchanged), a 16-color terminal palette, and a wallpaper set. Terminal ANSI colors are derived, not hand-picked - see scripts/generate-theme-qml.py's sibling note and design/tokens/README (hue-rotated from each theme's own accent, black/white kept on a fixed dark-to-light ramp independent of theme mode - a real bug in the first pass, inverted black/bright_black on light themes, caught by inspecting output before this file was written).

sapphire.label: Sapphire
sapphire._comment: Adopted as the default theme 15 Sept 2026 - Akash supplied this navy/gold luxury palette, previewed live end-to-end (chrome, kitty terminal, wallpaper), then confirmed as the new default (NOT a workspace-color change - the six workspace identity hues stay untouched per this file's own top-level comment). Mapped his 6 named roles onto the 5-slot chrome+accent schema: Midnight Navy->surface, Sapphire Blue->surfaceRaised, Pearl White->textPrimary, Champagne->textSecondary, Antique Gold->accent. Warm Brass (#C79C5A, his 'secondary accents/borders') has no dedicated slot in this schema and isn't used - noted here rather than silently dropped. Theme.qml's activeTheme default and jazz-theme-set --restore's fresh-install fallback both point here now (generate-theme-qml.py, jazz-theme-set); Forge remains the corruption-safety fallback only.
